snippet.title: Stick and Stack Gameplay Teaser - Q2 2025
snippet.description:
Stick and Stack is a tetris-like game but the pieces are all sticky!
Wishlist on Steam now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3655080/Stick_and_Stack

I've been working on this game on a free-time basis for just over a year. And now it's almost done, I will be running a public-ish beta test within a few weeks. If you're interested in joining in or following along with development you can join my discord here https://discord.gg/NANGAkcHVG
You can also follow my game dev on X @cammymoop and or bluesky @cammymoop.bsky.social

(bangin music by @Keestak)
